# Royal Flush

> Royal Flush provides portable toilet, special event restroom, restroom trailer, holding tank and hand-washing station rentals in Virginia Beach and Hampton Roads. Sister company to [Back Bay Boxes](https://www.backbayboxesvb.com/) roll-off dumpster rentals.

Services: standard portable toilets, special event portable toilets, high-end event restroom trailers, holding tanks, hitch-and-go trailer portable toilets, and hand sanitizer / washing stations.

Hours: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Contact: (757) 377-3603 · service@royalflushbbb.com
